reviews.title: Commercials
reviews.text: I used to love this game but lately it has been inundated with seriously annoying commercials that pop up randomly just seconds apart when you’re trying to place a set of blocks. Some last for 2 or 3 seconds, others last 5 to 10 seconds. Honestly, I can’t even tell you who the advertisers are because I get so aggravated. I understand the need for commercials but could you pretty please put them between games instead of ruining what was once a relaxing game. If this aggravating annoyance continues, I may have to seek out another similar game.

reviews.title: Frustrating ads!
reviews.text:
I’ve been playing this game for years and I normally don’t mind ads, but something changed recently and it’s become frustrating to play. The ads pop up so often you can’t get through a game. It’s so disruptive to game play that I’m ready to dump it all together. And some ads have popped up so often that I no longer want to buy the products either! Please fix this glitch!

Added weeks later… so glitchy that after deleting and reinstalling it won’t even open! Guess that’s it for this game I’ve been playing for years!

reviews.title: Ads Suddenly Popping into the Game
reviews.text: I have enjoyed this game for a long time. Despite waiting patiently for ads after almost every round of play, I have found this to be a good mental and visual/spatial challenge in a game. But in the last 2 weeks, something new has started happening…ads now pop up in the middle of a game and cover up the game board. What the heck????  This is incredibly annoying!  I will be moving a block to a board location when BAM! Ad pops up and covers the whole game board.  I can’t see anything. I have to stop mid-move and wait for the ad to clear, but the ad will likely pop up again 2 or 3 times in short succession. I hate to give up this game, but if this continues, I will say goodbye!!

reviews.title: Screen black outs mid-game!
reviews.text:
Loved this game but recently ads started popping up in the middle of a game, usually while I’m trying to place a piece.
The ads are at the top of the screen and the rest of the screen goes black. If you try to clear it another one pops back up with the same black screen. I have updated, uninstalled and reinstalled hoping it would go back to how it was with ads just in between games but no luck. Bummed to not be able to play this anymore.
Such a relaxing ☺️ game
